$comment: TEST FIXTURE -- the COVERAGE verb's repository. Four lanes, one per answer this verb has to have: a report it parses, a lane that declares no artifact at all, a lane whose artifact is not a report, and a lane whose declared report is not on disk. Separate from shu-repo because that one is the EXECUTOR's fixture and deliberately declares no coverage artifacts -- folding the two together would delete the 'declares none' case. Not shipped; see ../../README.md.

coverage.why: The lane the parse is proved on end to end. `artifacts` names the file the tool writes; nen parses the FIRST entry whose format it recognises and never searches for one.
DECLARES NO ARTIFACTS. The run succeeds and nen has nothing to parse: the refusal names the field to declare and quotes the reference pack's advisory location for this stack, which it never opens.
An artifact that is real and is not a coverage report in any format nen reads. The refusal lists the formats rather than guessing at this file.
A declared report that is not on disk after a successful run: exit 1 naming the path, because the tool wrote it somewhere else or wrote nothing.
